explication: JADX MCP Server exposes Android reverse-engineering tools to an MCP client, forwarding requests to the JADX plugin and returning live APK context. The principal workflow is client tool invocation → server dispatch → analysis request to JADX → tool result. Distinct capabilities include class inspection, code search, resource and manifest analysis, cross-reference lookup, refactoring, comments, and debugging. Pagination supports large class, resource, search, and reference results. The README documents the plugin-to-JADX-GUI interaction; source excerpts do not show its implementation, so that relationship is documented rather than inferred from code.
